question: 'SVANidhi se Samridddhi' programme launched in 2022 is associated with the Ministry of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Housing and Urban Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PM SVANidhi is an acronym that stands for Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi.
 
• It is a public-sector initiative that will be implemented in June 2020.
 
• Its goal is to give microcredit to street sellers afflicted by the COVID-19 outbreak.
 
• Initial operating capital of up to Rs 10,000 would be supplied to vendors.
 
• A vendor will receive a 7% interest subsidy if the loan is repaid early or on schedule. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

__
 
• M/s Quality Council of India (QCI)__ has been appointed as implementing partner for the program.
 
• Under this scheme, the complete profile of each PM SVANidhi beneficiary and their family members will be prepared.
 
• The benefits of the various eligible central schemes will be extended to the beneficiaries based on the profiled data.
 
• In the first phase,125 cities have been selected for the program.
 
• Prior to the complete roll-out, the MoHUA will run a pilot program in six cities-
 
 
• Gaya, Indore, Kakching, Nizamabad, Rajkot, and Varanasi
 
 
 
• The States/ UTs will have the option to extend their respective State/UT-specific welfare schemes to the beneficiaries under PM SVANidhi.
